metadata.method_name: Frozen cross-family consensus c_score_align (V0) on E2-B, a second untouched L25 sample
metadata.description: E2-B: 400 untouched MALLS-train sentences (>=25 words, >=3 conditions) drawn by E2's frozen rule; 10 generator slots; labels by E2's byte-identical solver + blind panel; scores sealed before labels. Orientation: higher = more likely unfaithful.
